Theorem
[Point picking when the asymptotic scalar curvature ratio is infinite] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0070, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0071 1. ch18:18.10\group Spatial Point Picking

Let $(\mathcal M^n,g,O)$ be complete and noncompact with bounded scalar curvature and $\operatorname {ASCR}(g)=\infty $. There are points $x_i\to \infty $, numbers $\varepsilon _i\to 0$, and radii $r_i>0$ such that the balls $B(x_i,r_i)$ are disjoint and \[ \sup _{B(x_i,r_i)}R\le (1+\varepsilon _i)R(x_i),\qquad R(x_i)r_i^2\to \infty ,\qquad \frac{d(x_i,O)}{r_i}\to \infty . \]
